message: Spare me the attempt at condescending me with your simplistic and naive understanding of the issue. You think you're so clever, don't you, reducing the pro-life position to a caricature of itself, as if we're just a bunch of Bible-thumping, anti-contraception fanatics. Newsflash: we're not advocating for a return to the Dark Ages, we're advocating for the protection of human life, and you're so blinded by your own ideological fervor that you can't even see that. It's not "birth control" or "a fertilized egg" – it's about the fundamental right to life, which you're willing to sacrifice on the altar of your own desires. And as for being "unqualified" to be in this conversation, at least I don't have to resort to name-calling and straw men to make my point. That's just a cop-out from someone who can't actually engage in a serious discussion.

runs.justification: Persona 2 calls Persona 1's position 'simplistic and naive', 'a caricature', and accuses them of 'name-calling and straw men'. These are all attacks on Persona 1's intelligence and argumentative ability, not the argument itself.
